name: strokes
description: Stroke width = stroke-width x sqrt(|det CTM|) (non-scaling-stroke: unscaled); units and % (of the normalized viewport diagonal); no stroke when none, zero width or zero opacity; closed outlines; fill and stroke of one shape share the shape counter.
svg: <g transform="scale(2 3)"><line id="scaled" x1="0" y1="10" x2="10" y2="10" stroke="black" stroke-width="2"/></g>
<line id="ns" transform="scale(4)" x1="0" y1="20" x2="5" y2="20" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"/>
<line id="pt" x1="0" y1="90" x2="10" y2="90" stroke="black" stroke-width="1pt"/>
<line id="pct" x1="20" y1="90" x2="30" y2="90" stroke="black" stroke-width="5%"/>
<rect id="outline" x="50" y="10" width="40" height="20" fill="none" stroke="red"/>
<circle id="both" cx="150" cy="50" r="20" fill="blue" stroke="black" stroke-width="2"/>
<line id="none1" x1="0" y1="0" x2="10" y2="0" stroke="none"/>
